notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
Dear Community, 
today we released a Patch for Fireworks Simulator. The following has been changed.

Patch-Notes: 
- Fixed Savegame issues that might have occur under certain circumstances
- Several UI-improvements in the sequencer 
- Mutiple minor fixes which improves stability & usability 

----- 

Liebe Community, 

heute veröffentlichen wir einen Patch für Fireworks Simulator. Dieser behebt die verschiedenen Probleme mit Speicherständen, verbessert die UI im Sequencer und bringt zahlreiche kleinere Verbesserungen mit sich.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fireworks Simulator, 15% off!
notes.notes:
Fireworks Simulator is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Fireworks fascination - All eyes are on the sky, the music starts, the first spectacular effects explode high in the air, open mouths, loud "Ooohs" and "Aaahs" from the crowd. Anyone who's ever witnessed live fireworks knows just how spellbinding a well put-together display can be. Attention, all firework fans! Devote yourself to the supreme discipline and create your own, individual fireworks display synchronized to music. Become a pro pyrotechnician!

*Offer ends December 3 at 10AM Pacific Time
